answer: Agents bond stake to an identity commitment and evaluate an epoch polynomial to produce rate-limit proofs tied to Semaphore membership and an epoch-scoped nullifier. Reusing that nullifier for distinct messages exposes two polynomial evaluations; Shamir interpolation then recovers the private key, furnishing verifiable evidence for immediate collateral slashing. The marble, atlas, and violet labels may name epochs or domains, but cannot make duplicate proofs unlinkable within one domain.
